==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a rocky pink canyon. In front of me is a large lake. Reaching out of the lake are long tendrils of pink thread.

Shadows within the canyon shift and morph into monsters that rise out of the ground. A dragon, a minotaur, and a flying seahorse. All three of them radiate a malevolent red energy.

I try to command the threads from the lake to take the shape of a hero to protect me. The threads from into the shape of a winged woman. Before I can finish crafting her, my alarm goes off and I wake up.
